第30章 沈曼的主动-《重生2000：撕了协议我暴富了》

海风带着咸涩的湿意，吹散了深南大道的暑气。

三层高的豪华游艇静静停泊在深圳湾的专属泊位上。

通体雪白的流线型船身，在泊位射灯的照耀下，泛着冰冷昂贵的金属光泽。

顾城留卖给临川的这艘玩具，全长超过八十尺。

上层甲板是露天酒吧和恒温按摩池，下层是顶级红木铺设的会客厅和三间独立主卧。

几个人踩着柚木甲板登船的那一刻，张天爱连呼吸都放轻了。

“林总，这……这也是您的？”张天爱小心翼翼地摸着真皮包裹的栏杆，眼睛瞪得像铜铃。

“嗯嗯，最近买的。”林川走到吧台前，随手拿起一瓶已经醒好的罗曼尼康帝。

陈璐站在甲板边缘，端着香槟的手微微收紧。

她在头等舱飞了五年，见过不少有钱人。但那些人大多挺着啤酒肚，满嘴的高尔夫和投资回报率。

像林川这种，二十出头，穿着几百块的休闲衬衫，却能把这种顶级奢华驾驭得像喝水一样自然的，她第一次见。

这已经不是钱的问题了。

这是底蕴，是圈层，是绝对的上位者气场。

夜风吹过。

乔乔穿着黑色的修身吊带裙，故意走到风口。

海风把薄薄的布料紧紧贴在身上，勾勒出极具攻击性的曲线。

她端着酒杯，走到林川身边。

“林总平时工作那么忙，还要抽空陪我们蔓蔓，真是辛苦了。”

乔乔笑得很甜，身体微微前倾，领口那一抹雪白在甲板的暖光灯下晃得人眼晕。

林川靠在吧台上，手里晃着红酒杯。深邃的目光透过暗红色的液体，落在乔乔脸上。

挺漂亮。会来事。懂进退。

这种八分女放在外面，绝对是那些暴发户和富二代抢着砸钱的尤物。

但在林川眼里，太刻意了。

她那些小动作，那种急于推销自己的眼神，就像个在橱窗前拼命招手的廉价商品。

反观不远处的沈蔓。

她穿着素雅的白裙子，安安静静地坐在沙发上。

海风把她的长发吹得微乱，眼神里那种患得患失的娇媚，还有那种被他彻底开发出来的女人味，才是最迷人的。

不是一个等级的东西，林川连多看一眼的兴致都没有。

“不辛苦。”林川淡淡地回了一句，目光直接越过她，看向沈蔓，“蔓蔓，过来。”

沈蔓立刻站起身，快步走到他身边。

林川极其自然地揽住她的腰，把她往怀里带了带。

乔乔脸上的笑容僵了一瞬，识趣地退到了一边。

但她眼底的那丝不甘，却越烧越旺。

游艇在海面上转了一圈，凌晨一点，缓缓靠岸。

奥迪A8L已经等在泊位旁。

司机小王把四个女孩送回宿舍。

张天爱叽叽喳喳地说了一路，陈璐偶尔附和两句。

车子停在小区门口。

“今天谢谢林总。”陈璐礼貌地下车。

乔乔走在最后。她弯腰下车的时候，手里的包不小心掉在了真皮座椅上。

她伸手去捡，手指极其隐蔽地在林川的手背上划了一下。

指尖带着一丝温热。

同时，一个小小的纸团落在了林川的掌心。

The sea breeze carries the salty moisture, blowing away the heat of Shennan Avenue.

The three-story luxury yacht is quietly moored in an exclusive berth in Shenzhen Bay.

The snow-white streamlined hull glows with a cold and expensive metallic luster under the spotlight of the berth.

The toy ship Gu Chengliu sold to Linchuan was over eighty feet long.

The upper deck is an open-air bar and heated massage pool, while the lower deck is a living room paved with top-quality mahogany and three independent master bedrooms.

The moment a few people stepped onto the teak deck and boarded the ship, Zhang Tianai even breathed lightly.

"Mr. Lin, this...is this yours too?" Zhang Tianai carefully touched the leather-wrapped railing, his eyes as wide as copper bells.

"Yeah, I bought it recently." Lin Chuan walked to the bar and picked up a bottle of Romanée-Conti that had been awakened.

Chen Lu stood at the edge of the deck, her hand holding the champagne tightening slightly.

She had flown first class for five years and met many wealthy people.But most of those people have beer bellies and talk about golf and return on investment.

It was the first time she had seen someone like Lin Chuan, who was in his early twenties and wore a casual shirt worth hundreds of yuan, but could control this top-notch luxury as naturally as drinking water.

This is no longer about money.

This is the foundation, the circle, and the absolute aura of a superior person.

The night wind blew.

Qiao Qiao wore a black slim-fitting suspender skirt and deliberately stepped into the wind.

The sea breeze pressed the thin fabric tightly to the body, outlining extremely aggressive curves.

She held the wine glass and walked to Lin Chuan.

"Mr. Lin is usually so busy with work, but he still has to take time to spend time with our Manman. It's really hard work."

Qiao Qiao smiled sweetly and leaned forward slightly. The white gleam on her collar made people dizzy under the warm light on the deck.

Lin Chuan leaned on the bar, shaking a red wine glass in his hand.His deep gaze fell on Qiao Qiao's face through the dark red liquid.

Quite beautiful.Something will happen.Know how to advance and retreat.

This kind of eight-cent girl is definitely a beauty that the nouveau riche and rich second generation are rushing to throw money at.

But in Lin Chuan's eyes, it was too deliberate.

Her little movements and her eyes eager to sell herself were like a cheap commodity waving desperately in front of the window.

On the other hand, look at Shen Man not far away.

She was wearing a simple white dress and sitting quietly on the sofa.

The sea breeze slightly messed up her long hair, and the charming look in her eyes that worried about gain and loss, as well as the femininity that he had completely developed, were the most charming.

It was not on the same level, and Lin Chuan was not even interested in taking a second look.

"It's not hard." Lin Chuan replied lightly, looking directly past her and towards Shen Man, "Manman, come here."

Shen Man immediately stood up and walked quickly to his side.

Lin Chuan grabbed her waist very naturally and took her into his arms.

The smile on Qiaoqiao's face froze for a moment, and she stepped aside knowingly.

But the trace of unwillingness in her eyes grew stronger and stronger.

The yacht circled on the sea, and at one o'clock in the morning, it slowly docked.

Audi A8L is already waiting next to the berth.

The driver Xiao Wang took the four girls back to the dormitory.

Zhang Tianai chattered all the way, and Chen Lu occasionally chimed in a few words.

The car stopped at the gate of the community.

"Thank you Mr. Lin for today." Chen Lu got out of the car politely.

Qiao Qiao walked last.When she bent down to get out of the car, the bag in her hand accidentally fell on the leather seat.

She reached out to pick it up and scratched the back of Lin Chuan's hand with her fingers very discreetly.

There is a hint of warmth at the fingertips.

At the same time, a small paper ball fell into Lin Chuan's palm.
